notes.notes:
Fixed the functionality of Taunt; now it only affects attacks.

Added new animations for Gorbigon, Gram, Gatekeeper, and others.

Added alternative backgrounds for the events Down with Idols, Double, Double Toil and Trouble, Bloated Mite, and others.

Fixed a bug where the pet summon button did not respond to cursor hover.

Updated/fixed visuals for several units.

Fixed the stage of saving an event when exiting, for the battle against Millenis.

Fixed the awarding of the achievement “No Second Stages”.

Fixed the awarding of the achievement “If he dies, he dies”.

Fixed the Thundering Mountain set (4), where its effect did not account for health from items.

Fixed golem core activation when a pet is summoned, even if no cards were played.

Fixed the experience multiplier bug for solo games.

Fixed a bug where the number of Vanadis’ active ability charges was displayed incorrectly after exiting the game with the Greed Demon in the High Priestess tarot.

Fixed the barrier reset animation bug for Gorbigon.

Fixed gamepad navigation when choosing between 2 rewards.

Added a hotkey tooltip for the glossary opening button in events.

Fixed several issues causing chains on cards to display incorrectly in different situations.

Fixed the VFX direction for Battering Ram intention of the Shield Master Orc.

Changed the battlefield visuals in the Turmoil event.

Changed the battlefield visuals in the fight against Marshal Lupen.

Improved target selection logic for allies  in various situations (e.g., preventing allies from hitting the barrel while the bomber is present).

Fixed misaligned crowns on snakes in the heroes’ books.

Fixed a bug where minor allies could replace important ones in battle (e.g., a generic bandit replacing Kiara).

Now when viewing Vanadis’ card upgrades, the pet card no longer covers Vanadis’ mana.

Fixed visual issues (especially fire effects) in the Whose Side Are We On? event.

Fixed missing sound when hovering over available points on the Steppe map.

Removed display of certain technical cards in the battle log.

On the reward comparison panel, information is now centered whenever possible.

With 1 max HP, the HP bar is now displayed correctly instead of as a thin line.

Fixed a bug where, after the disappearance of a debuff that prevented seeing intentions, all intentions would appear the same.

The starting bonus will no longer disappear if the game is closed while on it.

Fixed an issue where start-of-run effects (e.g., doubling cards in the Emperor tarot) could fail to trigger.

Fixed a bug where Boots of Balance could leave cards unflipped during the pet death turn.

Fixed an issue where the corresponding Vanadis skin was not awarded after defeating Millenis.

Fixed a bug where enemy knowledge in the bestiary was not granted if that enemy was summoned during battle rather than being present from the start.

Fixed a bug causing the Phoenix card to burn and duplicate incorrectly.

The Troll’s Club no longer appears twice in battle.

Fixed an issue with opening cards while in an event with Sigismund.

Fixed a bug where the game could freeze during Millenis’ Deadly Touch.

Removed repeated damage animation from enemy multiattacks (test feature).

Fixed spacing between tooltip elements for consumables in battle.

Improved the battle log to show messages about card movement when buffs are triggered.

Fixed a bug where incorrect visual effects could appear on cards.

Fixed a bug where using the Stick attack with a long bow applied significantly more Exposed than intended.

Fixed a bug with cloning the Header card through the Eye Patch item buff.

Added display of the number of identical rewards received for ascensions when multiple are awarded.

Added voiceover for new backgrounds with disgruntled ritualists, Ghoul, The Turmoil, Azure Orc, Double, Double, Toil and Trouble, Helga, and Dwarf.

Added voiceover for redesigned mobs: Grenadier, Elf Provoker, Brother of Fire, Gorbigon, Grum, Azure Orc, Moggot, and Jabberwock.

Fixed dialogue in Vanadis’ travel notes.

Fixed music behavior during dialogues.

notes.title: KOTCL Developer Diaries - Digging Our Way to Release
notes.notes:
Knock, knock, travelers!

Work on the DLC is going as steadily as Conrad the dwarf’s gait—confidently, but with the occasional stumble. Unlike that lone dwarf, though, there are many of us! We actively support each other, and thanks to our teamwork, we make up for lost steps and head straight for release!

And while we're swinging our pickaxes, we sometimes manage to dig up raw material for new diaries—which we’ll be sharing right now! 

[spoiler]Yes, the author has spent way too much time in the dwarven lands.[/spoiler]

Let's begin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/4cdd930dd56b1cb861a11030c22329bb4cc0a2cd.png

Golden Rule of Mining — Never Dig Down!

Otherwise, you might find yourself in quite an unfortunate situation. Endless worm tunnels all around, dozens of eggs beneath your feet, and the roar of an angry mother-worm in the distance.
It’s a grim fate even for a seasoned warrior. But if you manage to sneak past the eggs unnoticed, luck might be on your side, and you could make it back to the surface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/a5efeb1449333d9f06d5a3b61794260619d6bcbc.png

I saw a lycan in the sauna, turns out he was going through a hairy situation.

There’s nothing better after a long day in the development mines than a good steam bath! Bjorn has already prepared his bath towel and he’s practicing his swings while waiting for the steam room to heat up. It'll do him good—he’s looking a little pale…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/2dcbe72bdce0019f0801076027bd0d1689366e27.png

Tarot Reading For the Release (Real This Time)

We asked our in-house astrologer to do a Tarot reading for the release. Then we remembered we don’t have one, so we turned to the internet for help. Here’s what the cards told us:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/b435f9fb18c7d6409d403e8d39adf9e547f68490.png

The Emperor The development process is under control, with structure and order being maintained. As long as you keep a tight hand on the situation, everything will go according to plan.

Strength Endurance and inner resilience are required from you now, but you have all the resources to overcome any challenges. The key is to stay confident and not give in to stress.

The Star The outcome will bring hope, inspiration, and satisfaction. The DLC will leave a positive impression and might even exceed expectations.

We were quite surprised and pleased with the result—meaning everything is going as planned! And as an ancient dwarven custom has it, when everything goes all-right, we deserve an ale-night! But it's still a bit early to relax, so we'll be saving the elven brew for the release.

How About Some Chit-Chat?

Hey everyone, it’s Andrew aka Innrey!

For a while, we’ve been going through the final points of our roadmap, and it looks like we’re getting close to checking off every last one! It’s incredibly satisfying to see those crossed-out lines on our list, and even more so to realize that we’ve completed almost everything.

We’re wrapping up work on the internal build and moving onto the polishing phase of the final product. Plus, we’re just about done with the input system for controllers—which means Steam Deck and gamepad support are almost here!

Once again, a huge thank you for your continued support! We’re confident that these final touches will make the game even better, and we truly hope the end result lives up to your expectations. There’s still plenty to do, but I have a feeling this release is going to be absolutely unforgettable!

See you in the next dev diaries and don't forget to wishlist the DLC!

notes.title: KOTCL Developer Diaries: Life After the Patch
notes.notes:
Knock-knock, travelers!

Last Friday, we released a mega-patch that revamped all the events in the game. We hibernated for the weekend and dreamt of new cards and a bug-free game...

We woke up in a new world. Your feedback on the patch charged us up better than the golem core itself—and this week has borne more fruit than the gardens of the gardener orc. Want to know how we spent the last 7 days? Here’s a quick recap!

[olist]
Hunting bugs (at this point, we’re not sure who’s the hunter and who’s the prey 😅)
Planning the DLC release. As Mortis says, a good route is half the victory!
Working on balance adjustments. THE GREAT NERF IS COMING!
Preparing a Valentine's Day surprise for you. You’ll find out about it next Friday!
[/olist]

Forward, friends! Join us on a perilous trek through the Rotten Bog, a fierce contest between orcs and demons, and, of course, a review of new enemies and the latest game news. Let’s go!

New Lands Emerging in the Rotten Bog!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/2c4741a0a33fddea74581999730a80b558e00743.jpg

New locations will soon appear on the map—here’s a glimpse of one of them. We’re eager to create a full-fledged landscape for complete immersion in the atmosphere of Midian!

We draw inspiration from Caspar David Friedrich and John Constable—any other artists you’d recommend?

We pour our hearts and souls into every detail, striving for an authentic sense of presence. We want you to not just play but be there—to stand on the swampy ground, watching the sunset, inhaling the damp air. But something still feels missing… Tell us, who would you place in this clearing? What do you think of the new illustration?

The Orc Spearman Pays a Visit to the Demons?

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/28a3ad04ec030e089b3ae0abcace63fbd4ce2cf6.png

Your relationship with the Orc Spearman is about to level up. You’ll be able to journey with him from the Steppes all the way to the Northern Gate! Get ready for endless stories of his exploits—like the legendary saga of how he jabbed an overgrown worm with his spear. You’ll have to listen to it all the way to the Castle (our condolences)…

But just imagine how he’ll sing of your deeds! Despite having no ear for music whatsoever, he might just compose an orc version of Toss a Coin to Your Witcher—about you!

And of course, he’ll always be there to lighten the mood after battle and break up Mortis’ heavy dialogues—not unlike Donkey from Shrek.

His sagas will be hard to forget, and his strength could turn the tide of battle at a crucial moment! So get ready for new storylines with the Orc Spearman!

The Mother of Imps Has a… New Addition?

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/d1f1cc5653276aba13e8d9192bd109e3ffa25f70.gif

The Northern Gate is now home to more than just orcs… The Castle has become so beloved by imps that they’re moving in with their entire families! Fighting travelers has become a family business for them, so brace yourselves—you’ll soon face young imps with new abilities!

Cheers!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/754d0fdb1f10788a0e839b6766d6d3dc8930d6b8.png

We’re preparing an ultimate alchemical reset! The cauldrons are bubbling, potion-makers are drenched in sweat, and soon you’ll be able to create your potion-making hits… But be extremely careful! Science is a tricky matter, so the trial-and-error method might turn out to be a little… painful.

Expect enhanced recovery elixirs which will not only restore HP, but also provide nice buffs. The catch is that you’ll have to make them using human (and not only human) blood.

Will you dare pick up the mortar and pestle?

How About Some Chit-Chat!

Hey everyone, it’s Andrew aka Innrey!

Last Friday, we released this massive patch and then went into hibernation over the weekend. When we woke up, our phones were flooded with notifications.

Bugs…

We’re receiving about 2 bug reports per hour, and I just want to say how much we appreciate you sending them in. That helps us immensely. We’ll fix the issues very soon. And while we’re testing solutions, here’s a status report on some temporary new dangers in the lands of Midian:

Worm-Trawling Bug
We recommend you avoid worm hunting for a while! Due to an anomaly in magical activity across the Crimson Steppes, the “Worm Trawling” event may experience bugs.

Code Fragments on Cards
Since Midian is a highly multicultural world, with an endless variety of languages, you may occasionally notice mysterious inscriptions on familiar cards. Please don’t be alarmed! The thing is we translate for you from dwarvish, orcish, goblin, elven, and even demonic dialects, and sometimes minor discrepancies occur.

Invisible Cards
Or new tricks of the crazy Court Mage…

We sincerely apologize for these bugs. Our team is small, but we’re working tirelessly to fix each and every error. A patch with fixes is coming soon.

Once again, thank you for your patience, bug reports, comments, and feedback. They mean the world to us and inspire us to keep going. As soon as we get the bugs under control, we’ll continue expanding the game—and we’d love to hear from you:


How do you like the patch?
What do you think of the new battle log and event log?
What were you expecting but didn’t quite get?


And now, an important confession… We’ve studied your comments, held counsel, ran tests, and… my friends, I was mortified by your secret that was revealed to me. Please, look me in the eyes and tell me honestly…

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/1c689271c528b0800fa35ba26ff2bf96719c456e.gif

How many times have you farmed that imbalanced set? How many times have you taken the same routes? Hunted the same elves?

Today, it’s time to put an end to this! Very soon, “the-imba-from-the-Frontier” will be no more! Get ready! We’re reworking…

The Spry Elven Set!

I’ve realized that I can’t avoid responsibility for this gear set any longer. Soon, it will be mercilessly nerfed (but other sets will also be improved)!

We’re also preparing a little Valentine’s Day surprise for you—I’m going to continue working on it right now. :)

See you in the next dev diary!

notes.title: KOTCL Developer Diaries: A Giant Update Already In The Game With A Discount!
notes.notes:
Knock, knock, travelers!

We released the largest patch since the release. In the patch, we reworked ALL events. Although we checked it through and through, some minor bugs can occur during the first few days after the release. If you notice something suspicious, please let us know. We will do our best to fix the situation as soon as possible.

We apologize for any possible inconveniences.

We would also like to thank everyone who took part in the open beta test. You have no idea how much you've helped the project—we're forever indebted to you!

If the patch note with all its technical details looks more like a spell scroll—don’t worry! Here’s what’s in the update:

We’ve added:

 Event Log—Now you can easily track your (not always so heroic) history.
 Battle Log—Rewatch your greatest victories or those runs where you collected the Elven set for the thousandth time…
 Event Notes on the Map—No more “Wait, where did I see that?!”
 Dozens of New Rewards—Get your inventory ready for fresh loot.


But that’s not all! You can also look forward to:

 New Golem Adventures (hope you like gardening!)
 Tarantino-style dialogues with the guards
 A bit of alchemy and potion brewing
 A fishing mini-game (you might not like the catch…)
 And, of course, new cards


It’s all already in the game! Are you still here? Then welcome to the festive edition of New Midian Chronicle!

We've worked hard to improve the game, but your feedback means the world to us! If you run into bugs or have ideas and suggestions, reach out on Discord or email us at: 4knockbugs@gmail.com. We read everything carefully and are happy to respond!

We've been swamped with playtesting and bug fixing this week, but no deadline can burn out our inspiration—we still have plenty to show you. Let’s go!

Event Log – Your Personal Book of Life

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/a384eb3686de9a016a471aa9cfb9e70633f2df54.png

Now, you can examine the threads of your fate under a magnifying glass. Your achievements and quest goals are neatly stored in the Event Log—clear as day. Reflect on your decisions, analyze storylines, and try to pinpoint, in which moment everything went wrong. Happy reading!

Bjorn’s New Multi-Level Card!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/1a5ce756ba2eaff2b290f89df48b1aea8605e3b1.png

This patch has us howling at the moon! Our artists went all out, creating four different artworks for a single card so you can upgrade it to your heart’s content! And that’s not all! So better get your deck ready!

The Orc Chief is Waiting!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/911b1e262ea1b0a8a2be3a75fd17492a507450fc.png

The bloody Crimson Steppes are a ruthless, merciless land where the weak won’t live long. To survive here one has to know their way around weapons. The only law here is the law of brute force.

Massive, fearsome, and relentless, the orcs know no mercy and feel no fear. They don’t build cities, sow fields, or forge metal—they take what they want.

Among them, Moggot is a living legend. His footsteps echo across the golden sands of the Steppes, and goblins whisper his name to scare their youngins.

Are you ready to challenge him? Hold on tight, because this fight might be the last in your current game…

Heaps of New Loot

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/35090103a136875a9046dd62b64b8a0dac7a0af4.png

We might need to raise the game’s age rating because now you can find:

 Necklace of teeth
 Dwarven blood, demon blood, elven blood, super-goblin blood
 An experimental growth elixir—guess whose fat it’s made from? Bon appétit!
 And dozens of other new items!


So, start clearing out your inventory!

How About Some Chit-Chat!

Hello from Knock’s kitchen! It’s Andrew aka Innrey, I’m here to share the secret recipe for this season’s biggest patch!

Ingredients:

 10,000 lines of code
 20 liters of tears spilled over bugs
 A cup of inspiration
 A pinch of almost-not-overdue deadlines


Simmer everything for 8 months over the heat of your likes and comments—until golden-brown, crispy, and bug-free game.

The secret ingredient? Your feedback!

Last week, we launched open beta testing, and I have only three words: You. Saved. Us! Huge thanks to all beta testers for your suggestions, bug reports, and comments! We’re a small team, and without you, it would’ve been much harder to find those seeds of chaos and glitches you uncovered.

So we had gathered enough feedback on OBT, triple-checked everything, crossed our fingers, and… the update is live!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36881171/3df7aa509f970d8a0f7bd0b5280fe82de681515f.gif

Honestly? We’re exhausted—but incredibly happy. It feels like a massive weight off our shoulders.

What’s next? We’ll head for DLC! The storm is behind us, the wind of your feedback is filling our sails, and your comments light the way like the North Star. Our weekend plan is to hibernate. On Monday, we’ll dive headfirst into the ocean of DLC tasks.

Thank you so much! We can feel your support almost physically, and it keeps us moving forward.

And, by the way, until February 7, you can get Knock with a discount! So if you were waiting for the opportune moment to grab the game—this is it! 🎉

See you in New Midian, and have a great weekend!

notes.title: Join the Beta Test of Our Latest Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We invite you to participate in the open beta testing of the upcoming update. After successful testing, we will release a huge patch for the game.

Get ready for:
🔸 Follow ups of your favorite events
🔸 New events
🔸 Interface improvements
🔸 Event log
🔸 Battle log

How to join the open beta test: 
🔸 Launch Steam and right-click on Knock on the Coffin Lid.
🔸 Select Properties and go to the betas tab.
🔸 Next to “Beta Testing,” choose the branch “public_beta - public beta branch.”
🔸 Wait for Steam to update.

Important: The beta version is intended for Windows only and may contain bugs. Therefore, before installing the beta, please finish your current runs and back up the "Knock" save folder located at:
C:\Users[YourUsername]\AppData\LocalLow\RedBoon\Knock

If any issues arise with the beta version, you can disable it at any time and return to the main branch

If you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback, you can:

1. Use the “Bug report” feature in the game menu after pressing Esc.
2. Describe the issue in the “Open Beta Test” thread in the Steam Community Discussions.
3. Contact us in our Discord server 
4. (If the above doesn’t work) Email us at 4knockbugs@gmail.com with the contents of your “Knock” folder attached.

Thank you so much for your support, your feedback means the world to us!

notes.title: KOTCL Developer Diaries: One Week After Release. We're Alive!
notes.notes:
Knock-knock, travelers!

This is Andrey, aka Innrey, founder of RedBoon. The first week has passed, and I wanted to take a moment to talk to you and share some updates.

First and foremost, I want to express my immense gratitude to everyone who has noticed us. There are so many of you that we’re still in shock. At the same time, we couldn’t be happier that our game has garnered so much attention. Thank you all for your streams, your attention, your feedback, and your incredible support! We see, watch, and read everything you’re saying, and it’s incredibly inspiring for us. We’re working hard to improve the game and promise that, thanks to your feedback, we’ll be able to bring it to perfection in the coming months.

Let me share some numbers. The average time spent in KOTCL is 14 hours (which is already great), and the average daily number of players online is around 1600. Our record is approximately 2500 players at once! That’s a huge number for us (and our bugs).

Speaking of bugs, yes, given that we didn’t expect such a huge surge of "playtesters," things turned out the way they did. Unfortunately, we simply didn’t have the capacity to test everything as thoroughly as you have. But thanks to your reports, we’re managing to fix them quickly. As one of our players said on our Discord server, “If there are no bugs in your program, it just means you haven’t found them yet.” And that’s true :) So, we’re still tackling a mountain of bugs, but it’s rapidly shrinking. At the very least, we’ve already fixed most of the critical issues that were breaking the game.

This past week, we’ve really been on a roll. We haven’t slept much, but we’ve gotten a lot done. So, we’ll probably take a few days to rest and catch up on sleep. After that, with fresh energy, we’ll dive back in full force! We promise to reduce the number of patches and do more testing so you can enjoy the game without issues. notes.title: Official Release of Knock on the Coffin Lid: Prolog
notes.notes:
Friends!

We are thrilled to announce the release of the free-to-play game Knock on the Coffin Lid: Prolog! We can't wait for you to immerse yourselves in our dark and mysterious world.

Please share your impressions with us, as your feedback is incredibly important. We look forward to seeing you all on our Discord server. Your valuable input will help us make the game even better!

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Midian, a land full of fantastical creatures, magic, and mysteries. Embark on a dangerous journey alongside Persival, a brave warrior of the Northern Gate's lord, who has been resurrected after a mysterious death.

The card-based combat system allows you to collect, combine, and upgrade cards, creating unique strategies for each battle. A diverse array of weapons and armor will aid you in overcoming adversaries. Speaking of which…

On your journey, you will encounter numerous unique characters and dangerous enemies, each with their own story and characteristics. Sometimes, you will need to use all your skills to overcome them.

The game also features a Challenge Mode, which is a more classic roguelike experience. It allows you to find and test new strategies while also providing pleasant bonuses.

We are grateful to everyone who supported us along the way. Your feedback and suggestions have helped us create a game we are truly proud of.

We invite you to lift the coffin lid and discover what awaits on the other side. Knock on the Coffin Lid: Prolog is now available on Steam. Join us in this adventure!

notes.title: KOTCL Developer Diaries: the final CBT before the release
notes.notes:
Knock-knock, travelers! In today’s diary, we continue sharing the development results for this week. We hope you love numbers. Enjoy your reading!

So, this week we have:

- Created 36 icons for events on the map.
- Created 10 images for new battle cards.
- Improved 6 hero portraits.
- Added 24 new character animations.

And all in one month we have:

- Fixed more than 120 bugs.
- Addressed game freezes.
- Fixed issues with card descriptions and their operation.
- Corrected translation errors.
- Started closed beta test,

and much more. Details below!

Launch of CBT

If you've been following our news, you probably know that we've started closed beta testing. The update will bring a vast amount of new content, which we hope CBT participants will enjoy. Through this testing, we aim to gather feedback from our most dedicated players about the modifications we've added to the game in the last 6 months. We carefully examine your feedback and suggestions to make KOTCL the highest quality and most enjoyable game possible. Beta testing will help us gather even more feedback before releasing the final version.

We have extended the acceptance of applications for participation in the CBT until Sunday, 10/01/2023. We remind you that if you have played more than 20 hours and want to participate in the CBT, leave a request with your Steam ID in our Discord (test thread).

Visual effect improvement for buffs and debuffs 

One of the innovations we'd like to share with you is the adjustment of the battle UI/UX. This task turned out to be more challenging than we expected because sometimes the list of all buffs and debuffs above the heroes was so long that the descriptions could take 20-30 seconds to appear; if overlapping was turned on, the text became entirely unreadable. As a result, to ensure you don't miss out on what happens to your character during battle, we filtered out and removed some buffs and kept the most important and non-obvious ones. Besides, we’ve re- introduced a universal animation that appeared in the earliest builds! (Do you remember how long ago that was?) That is, displaying buffs and debuffs as arrows of different colors: golden-white for buffs and blood-red for debuffs. We look forward to hearing feedback on this feature from CBT participants and are ready to make adjustments.

[previewyoutube=jYHn9c7pCNY;full][/previewyoutube]
Event journal

Another important innovation is the event journal, which we added to make the gameplay easier and clearer.

As the name suggests, the event journal is a record of your actions, but not only that. It provides a brief description of the events you’ve visited and tells you what has happened. The journal is your assistant in tracking the progression of events, which can now change if you revisit the events. The journal helps players keep track of key moments and storyline developments. Do you like this idea? Feel free to write your thoughts in the comments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/cb85c85eb92fa2b6a3794b89b4a8ade87943d9c4.jpg

Continuing animation work

As usual, let's talk a bit about animations. Sergey a.k.a. Animatoid shared his vision of the animation for Vanadis’ second class – the Raven's Sister. Unlike other characters, this animation “has a beginning" rather than being just a looping motion. This new approach sparked a lot of debate: will it cause discomfort when switching between classes? Will such a difference be too noticeable? What are your thoughts here?

[previewyoutube=0sH6u9f9ql0;full][/previewyoutube]
Comedy moments

The process of creating animations can be very interesting and fun, not only for animators but for the entire development team. Sergey shared some animations with us as they appeared during his work, and we decided to show them to you. In the first picture, Vanadis got a bit "stuck" in the textures. It looks like she really doesn't want to let go of the raven and is holding onto his tail, much to the bird's displeasure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/1b12edfdf616b9d67c3e123df92c734859d9e782.png
Later, while trying to fix this animation, we encountered some slight issues with Vanadis's facial expression, and now she looks slightly arrogant :) During work, we always try various options in order to eventually choose the best one of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881171/87ccfc27fec0f763f64a67c61b80a49024725cf1.png

And of course, we ended up with a few funny moments. Here's a dynamic video we came up with while creating the animation for the "Turmoil" event. It won't be in the game, but we decided to share this creation with you. We hope you enjoy your weekend as much as the folks in the video!

[previewyoutube=R-pHrfraWZc;full][/previewyoutube]
Sum-up

Those are all the highlights for this week! To stay updated on the latest news, don't forget to subscribe to our social media channels, where you can also interact with the developers and ask any questions you have.

See you in the next diary!
